item.title: The Divide Podcast
item.description: Through investigative journalism, Shania Castro looks into the deep divide of North and South Korea as well as the divide in the two-party political system in America. Tune in to WNEC-FM 91.7 on Sunday between 11:30 AM-3:00 PM to hear music and the latest episode of The Divide.
